## About
Cerise Auto Body is a body shop on Cerise Avenue in Hawthorne, just off El Segundo Blvd. We fix collision damage and take care of the smaller details too, like tail lights, emblems and window tint.
We're open Monday through Friday, and you can reach us by phone or e-mail. Drivers have given us a 4.5 rating across 29 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collision damage: Fixing the damage after an accident.
- Tail lights and emblems: One reviewer had tail lights done and emblems colored to change the look of the car.
- Window tinting: Tint for the windshield and front windows.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. We're closed on weekends.

A: 13020 Cerise Avenue in Hawthorne, just off El Segundo Blvd.

Q: How do I reach you?
